description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Verdurous Gearhulk and Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding {C}{C}.
Corridor Monitor dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Verdurous Gearhulk, adding {C}{C}.
Verdurous Gearhulk dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Corridor Monitor, and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature(s) you control.
Repeat.
